experiment: exp40r -- mini-Duneau calibration harness, REVIVAL re-run on the Mac (doc 22 SS9 / doc 65 SS6.7)
spec: doc 22 SS9 (frozen, unchanged); doc 65 SS2.3 hygiene; target Duneau et al. arXiv:2409.08777

provenance.note: The August WSL implementation is COMMITTED and present on this box; it was reused UNMODIFIED rather than re-implemented. Only drivers, the trajectory trainer, the smoke battery, the Arabic diagnostic and this aggregator are new. results_exp40b.json was opened read-only and is unchanged.

config.ansatz_note: Sim-et-al Circuit 4. follows acts on 3 wires (follower, followee, fresh ancilla traced at readout) with SIX layers; question effects on 2 wires with THREE layers. doc 22 SS9 says '3 layers'; the 6-layer follows block is an August deviation carried forward (see module docstring). results_exp40b.json's own config.ansatz string is STALE and does not record it.

c5_calibration.verdict_rule: >=1 of 5 seeds: 100% train AND 100% validA AND >=95% valid_comp

smoke_battery.description: designed-to-fail builds per doc 65 SS2.3, run BEFORE the calibration; every bar declared in source before any run

tests.name: S3_story_blind
tests.bar: acc == 0.5 exactly (untrained AND after 5 epochs) and all story values identical to 1e-06

tests.name: S4_wrong_order_compile
tests.refit_note: model independently refit with exp40r_trainer at the same seed/config because exp40_mini_duneau.train_seed does not expose its checkpoint and is not modified

arabic_diagnostic.stage: exp40r Arabic diagnostic block (NOT exp42; no gate evaluated, no doc 22 SS7 verdict computed)
arabic_diagnostic.purpose: does training move at all on the clean exp41r dataset, and does the August all-arms-at-chance event reproduce
arabic_diagnostic.hypothesis_under_test: the August structured arms were UNDER-TRAINED (30 epochs, best-val-epoch reporting), not untrainable

config.init: uniform[0, 2*pi) -- AUGUST PARITY, deliberately; doc 65 SS2.4 registers N(0, 0.1^2) for exp42 proper. Flagged to the parent as a live variable.

summary.reading_key: honest >> scrambled on train AND val above chance => task signal extracted. honest ~= scrambled => memorization only, August event reproduces on clean data.

arabic_diagnostic_trajectory_note: Per-epoch curves (clean_train_acc, mean_loss, mean_grad_norm, running_train_acc) are retained in full above -- they are the instrument the August run lacked. Only the sparsely-populated per-epoch `eval_acc` list (validation was scored every 5 epochs, so it is mostly nulls) is dropped here; `final_eval_acc` is kept. The complete unabridged record, including `eval_acc`, is in exp40r_arabic_raw.json.
flagged_ambiguities: doc 22 SS9 specifies '3 layers Sim Circuit 4'. The calibrated harness uses SIX layers for the `follows` block (3 for the question effects). This is an August deviation, documented in exp40_mini_duneau.py's source but NOT in results_exp40b.json, whose config.ansatz string still reads '3 layers' and is therefore STALE. The oracle check finds the authors' repo uses 3 layers uniformly, so this is a genuine divergence from the replication target, carried forward because it is what passed C5 in August and re-passes it here.
doc 22 SS9's parenthetical 'NeurIPS-2024 compositional-learning workshop oral' is not corroborated: arXiv:2409.08777 carries no journal-ref or venue and appears to be a preprint only.

doc 22 SS9's 'No public code or dataset exists' is FALSE for code (doc 65 SS6.5 already corrected this) and misleading for data: no dataset artifact is released, but the generator is public, so the data is fully regenerable.

The mini's splits are narrower than the paper's by pre-registered scope (doc 22 SS9 fixes widths 2-12): the authors use compositional validation 9-20 and a 21-30 test tier, and stratify by story density. Scoped deviation, not a defect, but the mini therefore calibrates a strictly easier regime than the published headline.
The Arabic diagnostic uses uniform[0, 2*pi) init (August parity), while doc 65 SS2.4 registers N(0, 0.1^2) for exp42 proper. Init is a live variable the parent owns.

hygiene.note: The Arabic diagnostic trains on `train` and reads `val` only; test_a/test_b/test_c (the doc 22 SS7 gate sets) were never evaluated, so exp42's pre-registered comparison is uncontaminated.
